_help: Extra wordings for the lines she repeats most (found by reading a tester's diagnostics logs: a pool of 3 to 30 lines heard dozens of times). Same rules as the other pack files: each key is an event or remark name, each entry one line. Merged in personality/dialogue.py. Run tools/repeat_report.py on a diagnostics ZIP to see which pools are still too small.
VehicleChanged_OnFoot: Back on your own two feet.
On foot. Don't go getting lost.
Out of the cockpit and into the wild.
Keep your suit sealed and your eyes open.
BioFarEnough: You've put some space between you and the last sample. Go ahead.
Distance is good. Sample when you're ready.
That's the gap sorted. Next sample.
Far enough, {distance} metres. Off you go.
Right, that's clear of the last one.
That's {distance} metres from the last one. Plenty.
Good spacing. Take the next one when you like.
Touchdown: Gear's down and so are we.
BoardedShip: The ship's glad to have you back.
Remark_Aussie: Reckon the kettle's on somewhere. Not here, though.
Fair crack of the whip, that's a long way.
Stone the crows, look at that.
Might be time for a cuppa. An imaginary one.
Remark_Dry: Do with that what you will.
Tone_Neutral_L4: I'd call this a good day. Quietly.
You're doing fine. Don't let it go to your head.
Not my worst crew. Getting closer to my best, lately.
Tone_Neutral_L5: I'm having a lovely time. Please don't repeat that.
I could do this all week.
Good company. Better than the ship's manual.
Tone_Friendly_L2: I like how this is going.
Nice and relaxed. I like it.
Tone_Friendly_L3: This is why I like flying with you.
CodexEntry: A new page in the codex.
NavRoute: That's the route in the computer.
Plan_Ask: So, what are we doing today, then?
What are we doing today, do you think?
Right, so what are we doing today?
Okay Commander, what are we doing today?
Where are we headed? What are we doing today?
Go on then, what are we doing today?
VeryHotWarning: Danger. It's dangerously hot out there.
VeryColdWarning: Danger. It's dangerously cold out there.
Warning. External temperature is critically low.
MassLocked: Mass lock. We're stuck for now.
Mass locked. Drive's offline until we're clear.
Mass lock on. Get clear to jump.
ShieldsDown: Shields are out, Commander. Get clear!
Shields down! I've still got your back.
HardpointsDeployed: Weapons hot, and so am I.
Hardpoints down. Ready when you are.
Guns out and ready to go.
Weapons armed. Try not to miss.
HardpointsRetracted: Weapons stowed. Good, I was getting twitchy.
Shutdown: Switching off. See you next time.
NSPInSystem: There's a notable stellar phenomenon in this system, Commander. Worth a visit.
Something unusual is out there. A notable stellar phenomenon. Shall we look?
Notable stellar phenomenon detected. I'd like to go and see it.
The scanner's found something rare in this system. A notable stellar phenomenon.
A phenomenon worth visiting is in this system. Check the navigation panel.
There's something beautiful in this system, I can tell. A notable stellar phenomenon.
Scan_NeutronStar: Neutron star here. The jet cone's worth a boost.
A neutron star, Commander. Keep clear of the cones.
Scan_WaterWorld: Water world here. Wet and wonderful.
Remark_Dark_Friendly: Lovely day for it. Nothing has exploded yet, and I'm choosing to call that a trend.
Good news: the hull is holding. Bad news: it's the only thing holding.
We're having a wonderful time and the vacuum is being very patient with us.
On the bright side, if anything goes wrong it'll be over very quickly.
Everything's fine. I've checked. Twice. The second time I was less sure.
I'm told space is trying to kill us. I think it likes us, really.
Remark_Dark_Neutral: Fun fact: the nearest help is a very long way off.
The ship is in good order. The universe is working on that.
Everything is within safe limits. Safe is a generous word.
We're surrounded by nothing that wants us to survive. Cheerful, isn't it?
Reminder: space is vast, cold, and entirely uninterested in us.
Odds are fine. I don't say that often. Enjoy it.
CommandUnknown: That one's not in my book, Commander.
I don't have a command for that. Try different words?
Heard you. Just don't know what that means yet.
I'm not sure what you wanted there. Could you say it another way?
That doesn't match any command I've got.
I didn't recognise that. Try it again, a little differently?
No command like that, I'm afraid.
Tone_Friendly_L1: Let's make it a good one.
Hello there. Ready when you are.
